title: NVML Reference Operating Point (calibration artifact)
description: Committed artifact produced from a READ-ONLY NVML telemetry sweep on the local RTX 3090 Ti (sm_86). One schema covers BOTH regimes, distinguished by the required anchor_regime field: (a) `sustained` — produced by tools/local_labels/calibrate_nvml_reference_operating_point.py under a sustained user-space CUDA workload that holds the card at its 90C SW-thermal boost-equilibrium operating point (~1350 MHz on this card); (b) `short_burst` — produced by tools/local_labels/calibrate_nvml_short_burst_anchor.py under short compute bursts sampled while the card is cool and NOT SW-thermal-throttled, capturing the full boost clock (~1.87 GHz) a short kernel actually sees. Records the per-host reference SM clock / temperature / power / memory clock, the read-only sampling method, and the accepted vs rejected sample counts with rejection reasons. The cycles->ns conversion selects the anchor by regime (short kernels use the short_burst anchor; consuming the sustained anchor for a short-regime conversion is rejected). CLAUDE.md Rule 2: read-only NVML only (no clock-lock/persistence/power/MIG mutation). Quarantined to data/local_labels/.

anchor_regime.description: First-class regime discriminator. `sustained` = the 90C SW-thermal boost-equilibrium operating point (sustained matmul; ~1350 MHz). `short_burst` = the cool, un-throttled full-boost operating point (short compute bursts; ~1.87 GHz) a short kernel sees. The cycles->ns conversion selects the anchor by this field and refuses to consume a sustained anchor for a short-regime conversion. Required so neither artifact can omit the discipline.

workload_class.description: Optional human-readable workload class that produced the anchor (e.g. user_space_cuda_matmul_sustained, short_burst_compute). Descriptive provenance; the load-bearing selector is anchor_regime.

device_name.description: NVML device name; must contain 'RTX 3090 Ti'.

n_accepted.description: Accepted (active, plausible, non-hardware-faulted) steady-state samples. >=1 required: the reference is never computed from rejected data.

sw_thermal_active_fraction.description: Fraction of accepted samples whose throttle bitmask carried SW_THERMAL_SLOWDOWN (the normal Ampere DVFS boost-equilibrium signal, recorded for provenance — NOT a rejection).

sm_clock_ref_mhz.description: Median accepted SM clock, MHz. The cycles->ns conversion uses this.
